jobs.title: Total Rewards Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT BESTOW

Life insurance is one of the world's most important products. It's also one of the hardest to build, distribute, and modernize. Bestow exists to change that.

Bestow is a leading vertical technology platform serving some of the largest and most innovative life insurers. Our platform unifies the fragmented, legacy value chain, enabling carriers to launch products in weeks instead of years. Carriers choose us to scale and operate at unprecedented speed, powered by AI and automation.

Bestow isn't selling policies. We're building the infrastructure that helps an entire industry move faster, reach more people, and deliver on its promise.

Backed by leading investors (Goldman Sachs, Hedosophia, NEA, Valar, 8VC) and trusted by major carriers, Bestow is powered by a team that moves with precision, purpose, and heart. If you want to help reimagine a centuries-old industry with lasting impact, join us.

Bestow offers flexible remote/hybrid work, meaningful benefits, equity, and substantial growth opportunities.

Bestow uses E-Verify to confirm the employment eligibility of all newly hired employees. To learn more about E-Verify, including your rights and responsibilities, please visit E-Verify.gov http://e-verify.gov.




ABOUT THE TEAM

Bestow is building a dedicated Total Rewards function for the first time. Today, compensation, equity, and benefits work is split across People, Finance, and Legal with no single owner. This role exists to own the full total rewards portfolio (pay, equity, and benefits) end to end, bring rigor to how Bestow benchmarks and communicates rewards, and partner closely with Finance, Legal, and the board's compensation committee as Bestow scales.

This is a hands-on, builder role at a company still standing up its Total Rewards infrastructure. Expect to both set strategy and do the execution work (Pave configuration, equity modeling, benefits renewals) in year one.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

As the Total Rewards Manager, you will:

 - Own Pave end to end: benchmark configuration (market cut, percentile, geographic tiers), comp cycle setup, and data integrity between BambooHR (HRIS) and Pave.

 - Manage the Total Rewards Assessment & Roadmap: audit current comp and benefits philosophy, market positioning, and tooling.

 - Maintain and refresh salary bands: anchor to a clear, consistently-applied benchmarking philosophy; review and resolve flagged band outliers by job family.

 - Partner on job leveling: bring consistency to a leveling framework and support a more standardized leveling process.

 - Own the bi-annual merit, promotion & bonus cycle: design and execution in Pave, partnering with Finance on budget and approval workflows.

 - Equity Administration: partner closely with Legal and Finance teams to maintain an up to date equity database

 - Manage overall equity program: ongoing market benchmarking of equity practices, equity analytics, and end-to-end execution of refresh and promotion equity cycles.

 - Assess geographic pay ranges: make the case for them as Bestow's workforce becomes more distributed.

 - Own benefits strategy: annual renewal strategy, plan design changes, and new offering evaluation (e.g., lifestyle spending accounts, wellness perks, voluntary benefits), in partnership with the broker.




WHO YOU ARE

 - Experienced: 5-8+ years in compensation, total rewards, or a closely related HR discipline, including direct experience with equity administration at a venture-backed or newly-public company.

 - Ops-rooted: Ideally began in or spent time in people operations.

 - Platform-fluent: Hands-on experience with a comp benchmarking/planning platform (Pave, Radford, or similar) and running end-to-end merit/comp cycles.

 - Equity-fluent: Direct experience managing equity programs: grant sizing methodology, equity analysis, refresh/retention programs, Carta or similar cap table tools, and board/compensation committee facing materials.

 - Benefits-savvy: Benefits strategy experience: renewals, broker management, and plan design decisions.

 - Analytically sharp: Advanced Excel/analysis skills; comfort building and defending a compensation model from first principles rather than following a template.

 - A strong partner: Excellent cross-functional partnership skills; this role works constantly with Finance and Legal, and needs to translate technical comp/equity concepts for managers and employees.

 - Bonus points: Experience standing up a Total Rewards function from scratch at a similarly-sized company (~100-250 employees); familiarity with job architecture/leveling framework design; insurance, fintech, or other regulated-industry experience.




TOTAL REWARDS

At Bestow, we’re proud to be awarded for our team members, innovative products, and culture. Our standard benefits for full-time employees include:

 - Competitive salary and equity based on role

 - Policies and managers that support work/life balance, like our flexible paid time off and parental leave programs

 - 100% paid-premium option for medical, dental, and vision insurance

 - Lifestyle stipend to support your physical, emotional, and financial wellbeing

 - Flexible work-from-home policy and open to remote

 - Remote and WFH options, as well as a beautiful, state-of-the-art office in Dallas’ Deep Ellum, for those who prefer an office setting

 - Employee-led diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives

Recent Employer Awards include:

 - Best Place for Working Parents 2023 + 2024 + 2025

 - Great Place to Work Certified, 2022 + 2023 + 2024 + 2025

 - Built In Best Places to Work, 2022 + 2023 + 2025

 - Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Texas 2022 + 2023

 - Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Financial Services and Insurance 2022 + 2023 + 2024

We value diversity at Bestow. The company will hire, recruit, and promote regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, pregnancy or maternity, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. We understand the importance of creating a safe and comfortable work environment and encourage individualism and authenticity in every team member.

Thanks for considering a job at Bestow!

ABOUT THE ROLE

This is the first hire on Bestow's Integrated Marketing team, and a generalist role by design. You'll be closest to how campaigns, events, and channels are actually performing in-market — with Sales, with buyers, with the numbers — and that vantage point directly shapes where Bestow's integrated marketing strategy goes next. You'll partner closely with the Director of Integrated Marketing to translate that read into strategy, then build the engine that runs it: turning strategy into live campaigns, running programs, and reporting results. The Director holds final accountability for direction, channel priorities, and overall investment, but shapes it together with you, not in isolation.

You'll execute demand gen and paid media, connect event investment to lead generation and the broader digital ecosystem, and run the day-to-day systems that tie channel activity to Sales outcomes — pipeline reviews, account-based programs, and attribution reporting.

This role reports to the Director of Integrated Marketing and is built for someone who wants real ownership over execution early, and a genuine voice in shaping strategy along the way: the chance to build process, run point across channels day to day, and grow the remit as the team scales. This role is open to Remote (US). #LIRemote




WHAT YOU'LL DO

Demand Generation & Paid Media

 - Plan and execute demand generation campaigns across paid digital, email and nurture, and organic channels, with a sharp eye on what drives leads and pipeline.

 - Manage paid media budgets and targeting to maximize efficiency and pipeline contribution.

 - Contribute to SEO/AEO efforts to ensure Bestow is discoverable at every stage of the buyer journey.

Sales Alignment & Pipeline Accountability

 - Run the pipeline review cadence with Sales and roll up a marketing-sourced number for the Director to bring into forecasting.

 - Lead win-loss analysis and feed insights back into targeting and messaging.

 - Manage Salesforce campaign structures and hygiene to ensure clean attribution and reporting across every program.

Channel-to-Revenue Programs

 - Own channel-to-pipeline attribution and ROI reporting across all campaign types, and use it to help shape what the Director prioritizes next.

 - Manage day-to-day partner/vendor relationships and execute budget allocation across channel, event, and ABM spend, working with the Director to set and adjust those parameters.

 - Design target account methodology and tiering with Sales, informing and executing against account priorities you help set together with the Director and Sales leadership, and build personalized account-based campaigns.

 - Track how account engagement correlates to pipeline movement and deal speed.

GTM, Systems & Enablement

 - Activate Product Marketing positioning into channel and ABM campaigns, feeding in-market signals back into battlecards.

 - Maintain and optimize the martech stack, and run an ongoing testing agenda across channel mix, account plays, and messaging.

 - Leverage AI tools to accelerate campaign execution, improve targeting, and scale personalization across channels.

 - Partner closely with the Director of Integrated Marketing, Creative, Product Marketing, Communications, and Sales to help shape — and then execute against — a consistent message and channel strategy.

Events & Integrated Campaigns

 - Execute the lead capture, scoring, and follow-up that connect events to the rest of the demand engine, and report event ROI and pipeline contribution back to the Director.

 - Ensure every event ties into concurrent digital and nurture campaigns, per the integrated strategy you help shape with the Director, so experiential investment reinforces — rather than sits apart from — other channels.




WHO YOU ARE

 - Proven experience in demand generation, integrated campaign, or revenue marketing roles in B2B, ideally SaaS or enterprise technology.

 - Motivated by owning execution and eager to bring your on-the-ground read on channels, campaigns, and Sales to strategy planning and review sessions.

 - A true generalist — you've run paid media, email/nurture, ABM, and events, and you're energized by breadth rather than narrow specialization.

 - Comfortable owning the connection between marketing activity and revenue: pipeline reviews, attribution, forecasting contribution, and win-loss analysis.

 - Experience building or running ABM programs, including account tiering and personalized account-level campaigns.

 - Fluent in Salesforce (or similar CRM) and marketing automation platforms; you know how to structure campaigns for clean reporting.

 - Data-driven — you track what matters and use performance data to continuously improve programs.

 - A builder's mindset: energized by creating structure and process from scratch as the first hire on a growing team.

 - Comfortable with AI-powered marketing tools and excited to use them to work faster and scale personalization.

 - A strong collaborator who can work across Marketing, Sales, and external partners (including agencies) to get campaigns out the door and performing.

 - Experience in fintech, insurtech, or a platform business is a plus.




TOTAL REWARDS

At Bestow, we’re proud to be awarded for our team members, innovative products, and culture. Our standard benefits for full-time employees include:

 - Competitive salary and equity based on role

 - Policies and managers that support work/life balance, like our flexible paid time off and parental leave programs

 - 100% paid-premium option for medical, dental, and vision insurance

 - Lifestyle stipend to support your physical, emotional, and financial wellbeing

 - Flexible work-from-home policy and open to remote

 - Remote and WFH options, as well as a beautiful, state-of-the-art office in Dallas’ Deep Ellum, for those who prefer an office setting

 - Employee-led diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives

Recent Employer Awards include:

 - Great Place to Work Certified, 2022 + 2023 + 2024 + 2025

 - Built In Best Places to Work, 2022 + 2023 + 2025

 - Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Texas 2022 + 2023

 - Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Financial Services and Insurance 2022 + 2023 + 2024

We value diversity at Bestow. The company will hire, recruit, and promote regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, pregnancy or maternity, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. We understand the importance of creating a safe and comfortable work environment and encourage individualism and authenticity in every team member.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Bestow Revenue team is transforming life insurance by giving carriers the technology platform to modernize their products and distribution. Our end-to-end enterprise SaaS platform lets carriers launch fully customized life insurance products in months, give customers and advisors a modern experience, and grow through continuous testing and iteration. That end-to-end approach is genuinely rare in insurance technology, and it means our customers avoid costly point-solution integrations.

This role reports to Bestow's Director of Customer Success and is open to Remote (US) #LI-Remote

WHAT YOU'LL DO

The Customer Success Manager owns the relationship, health, and growth of Bestow's enterprise carrier customers. You are the customer's primary point of contact at Bestow, and the person internal teams look to for a clear read on what the customer needs and why it matters. You will run your accounts end to end: performance, escalations, roadmap alignment, and the executive relationships that keep the business moving.

 - Own the day-to-day and executive relationship for a portfolio of enterprise carrier customers, serving as their primary point of contact at Bestow.

 - Run the operating rhythm for your accounts: recurring business reviews, performance reporting against service level objectives (SLOs), and quarterly planning with customer leadership.

 - Build and deliver executive-level business reviews that connect platform performance to the customer's commercial goals.

 - Own escalations end to end, from first signal through resolution and customer follow-up, coordinating Engineering, Product, and Implementation as needed.

 - Translate customer needs into prioritized work with Product and Engineering, and make the case with data when something deserves to move up the roadmap.

 - Identify expansion and adoption opportunities inside your accounts, and work with Sales on the path to close.

 - Own due diligence, compliance documentation, and audit responses for your customers, organizing subject-matter experts and holding deadlines. 

 - Mentor Customer Success Associates and raise the bar on how the team documents, reports, and communicates.

 - Travel as needed for solution workshops, leadership onsites, and customer business reviews.

WHO YOU ARE

 - 4 or more years in customer success or account management, ideally at a SaaS or technology company serving enterprise customers.

 - You have owned enterprise customer relationships directly, including executive stakeholders, and can point to accounts you grew or turned around.

 - Energized by complex problems and comfortable being the person accountable for the answer.

 - Fluent working cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Compliance, and Sales, and effective without formal authority.

 - Skilled at building and delivering polished, client-facing presentations for executive audiences.

 - Strong analytical instincts. You work with data directly and use it to make a case, not just to report.

 - Clear, direct communicator in writing and in the room, with real attention to detail.

 - Experience with CRM and ticketing tools such as Salesforce and JIRA.

 - Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
